scripts.test:prepare: pnpm test:env && pnpm db:test:up && pnpm db:test:migrate
scripts.test:build: pnpm --filter @repo/database db:generate && pnpm --filter @repo/shared build && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build:e2e
scripts.db:test:migrate: pnpm test:env && cross-env NODE_ENV=test pnpm --filter @repo/database db:migrate:deploy
scripts.db:test:reset: pnpm test:env && cross-env NODE_ENV=test pnpm --filter @repo/database db:reset
